title: On Nearly-Perfect Covering Codes Beyond Radius One
summary: We study (binary) nearly-perfect covering codes, which are codes that attain the Van Wee bound with equality. They act as the covering counterparts to nearly-perfect error-correcting codes, which attain the Johnson bound with equality. These codes have been completely classified for covering radius $R=1$. We prove that no code with $R\geq 2$ can attain the original Van Wee bound with equality, since it omits the dependence on the minimum distance of the code.
